title: 第1869章 苏总管第1868章 火种
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
据点不大，核心成员不过数百人。但他从暗渊带回的情报体系、从青云洞天获得的情报权限、以及两只噬天虫对虚冥族造物的精准感应能力，让这个小小组织在成立之初便拥有了远超规模的情报和行动能力。他给这个组织取名“归墟”，既是对那位虚冥族最后守望者的纪念，也是对他自己使命的隐喻。归墟老人的遗愿是守护虚冥族最后的火种，而他要做的是追踪暗渊残余势力、收集虚冥族遗物、保护不灭之魂。那个曾经暗无天日的代号，在他手中重新被赋予了截然不同的含义。
苏总管是最早得知归墟成立消息的外人。他主动登门，表示青云洞天愿意以最低价向归墟提供长期情报支持，换取归墟在探索虚冥族遗迹时获得的丹方和炼器图谱的优先购买权。江辰同意了。归墟有青云洞天的情报网作为支撑，又有太虚剑宗外门弟子的合法身份作为掩护，再加上江辰本人首席弟子的声望加持，很快便在永暗星域站稳了脚跟。
万仙城玄霜婆婆的召见，恰好赶在归墟成立后不久。这位万仙城三位太上长老之一的冰系天仙通过太虚剑宗的传讯阵法向他发来一份简短的密信，措辞依旧冷淡，只说他托她在藏经阁查阅的关于虚冥族螺旋秘文的资料，老身找到了些线索。速来。
江辰连夜赶到万仙城。玄霜婆婆在藏经阁第九层等他，依旧是那副拄着万年玄铁拐杖的老迈模样，但那双被皱纹包裹的老眼中却闪烁着极其罕见的郑重光芒。她从袖中取出一枚冰蓝色玉简，注入一缕仙元，玉简中的影像在虚空中投射出一幅残破的星图。星图标注的区域位于太虚仙域最外围与虚空深处的交界处，一颗偏远的废弃修真星，名为云隐星。星图下方还有几行用古老文字写成的简要记录，大意是说此星上曾发现过一座年代久远到无法追溯的上古遗迹，遗迹入口的石碑上刻有不明意义的螺旋状文字。
“这是老身年轻时游历太虚仙域时偶然记录下来的。当时老身不过天仙初期，无意中闯入那片星域，发现了那座遗迹。老身本想深入探索，却在遗迹入口遭遇了一头金仙级别的虚空古兽，拼尽全力才勉强逃脱。之后一直未能有机会返回，这张星图便压在藏经阁深处，一压便是数十万年。老身听说你与虚冥族有很深的渊源，这张星图与其继续在藏经阁里吃灰，不如交给你去一探究竟。”
江辰接过那枚冰蓝色玉简，神识探入其中，将星图完整刻入识海。云隐星的位置恰好位于永暗星域边缘，与归墟的新据点距离不远，战略位置极其关键。玄霜婆婆拄着拐杖站起身来，那张苍老的面孔上浮现出一丝罕见的温和：“老身年轻时的遗憾，希望你能替老身补上。”
玄霜婆婆留下的星图标注得极其详尽，但那毕竟是她年轻时留下的记录，数十万年过去，永暗星域的空间法则早已发生了不小的偏移。江辰带着不灭之魂和两只噬天虫，驾驶那艘太虚剑宗为他改装的小型虚空穿梭舰，在永暗星域边缘航行了数日才找到星图上标注的那颗废弃修真星——云隐星。舰载探测阵法在靠近星球时便已全面启动，反馈回来的数据让江辰微微皱眉：整颗星球表面没有任何生命迹象，没有灵气波动，没有地热活动，甚至连正常星球应有的地壳运动都完全停止了。这不像是一颗自然死亡的星球，更像是被某种力量从内部掏空了全部生机。
穿梭舰穿透星球稀薄到几乎不存在的大气层，在一片平坦得诡异的暗紫色荒原上降落。江辰踏出舰舱的瞬间，靴底踩到的地面触感让他眉头皱得更紧——那不是天然的岩石，而是被某种高温熔炼后又重新凝固的人造物质。他将神识全力散开，沿着地面向四面八方延伸，神识触及的每一寸土地都反馈回同样的信息：暗紫色的虚冥族阵纹，密密麻麻地覆盖了整片荒原，从地表一直延伸到神识无法触及的地下深处。这些阵纹的规模远超他在虚冥古墟和永暗星域暗渊据点见过的任何一处，它们不是被刻在建筑物表面，而是直接熔铸进了整颗星球的岩石之中。
不灭之魂跟在他身后走下舰舱。它的暗银躯体在荒原的暗紫光芒映照下微微闪烁，那双淡银眼眸在扫过地面上那些阵纹时忽然凝固了。它在原地站了很长时间，像是在努力回忆什么极其遥远的东西，然后将手掌贴在阵纹上闭上眼睛，感知许久后缓缓开口，低沉的虚空共鸣中带着一丝连江辰都未曾听过的复杂情绪：“是族人的气息。很古老，比归墟的老师更古老。在更深的地方。”它的手掌从阵纹上移开，指向荒原正中央那片微微隆起的地壳，“就在下面。”
江辰拔出噬渊剑。破虚剑诀第三式斩虚——融合了万星淬仙诀星辰法则的完全版斩虚式，一道长达数百丈的透明空间裂缝随着剑锋劈下，将覆盖在地表那层暗紫阵纹连同下方厚达数里的岩层一并整齐地切开。岩层被撕开一道巨大的裂口，裂口深处透出极淡却极其纯粹的暗金光芒。他带着不灭之魂沿着裂口向下飞去，越深入越发现这颗星球内部的震撼之处——整颗星球的地下早已被掏空，变成了一座由无数层虚冥族建筑堆叠而成的巨型立体迷宫。每一层建筑都是由虚空晶石整体雕琢而成，比他在太虚仙域见过的任何虚冥族遗迹都更加古老、更加宏大。在最深处，一座被完整封印的地下神殿静静地矗立着，神殿的外墙由数十丈高的暗金虚空晶石整体浇铸，门楣上刻着螺旋秘文，每一个字符都比虚冥之门上的更加古朴，还保留着虚冥族文字最原始的象形痕迹。封印的阵纹仍在运转，历经无数万年而不熄。
content_en:
The stronghold is small, with only a few hundred core members. However, the intelligence system he brought back from the Dark Abyss, the intelligence authority obtained from Qingyun Cave, and the two Sky-eating Insects' precise sensing ability of the Void Clan's creations gave this small organization an intelligence and operational capability that far exceeded its scale when it was first established. He named this organization "Guixu", which is not only a memorial to the last watchman of the Xuming tribe, but also a metaphor for his own mission. The last wish of the old man Guixu is to protect the last fire of the Xuming clan, and what he wants to do is to track the remaining forces of the Dark Abyss, collect the relics of the Xuming clan, and protect the immortal soul. The code name that was once unknown was given a completely different meaning in his hands.
Manager Su was the first outsider to learn about the establishment of Guixu. He took the initiative to come to the door and expressed that Qingyun Dongtian was willing to provide long-term intelligence support to Gui Xu at the lowest price in exchange for the right of first refusal to purchase the elixir recipes and weapon refining maps that Gui Xu had obtained while exploring the ruins of the Xuming tribe. Jiang Chen agreed. With the support of Qingyun Cave Sky's intelligence network, the legal identity of an outer disciple of Taixu Sword Sect as a cover, and the blessing of the reputation of Jiang Chen's chief disciple, Guixu quickly established a firm foothold in the Eternal Dark Star Territory.
Granny Xuan Shuang of Wanxian City was summoned shortly after Gui Xu was established. This Ice Celestial Immortal, one of the three Supreme Elders of Ten Thousand Immortals City, sent him a brief secret message through the Taixu Sword Sect's communication formation. The wording was still cold, and he only said that he had asked her to check the information about the spiral secret text of the Xuming Clan in the Sutra Pavilion, and I had found some clues. Come quickly.
Jiang Chen rushed to Ten Thousand Immortals City overnight. Granny Xuan Shuang was waiting for him on the ninth floor of the Sutra Pavilion. She still looked like an old woman leaning on a thousand-year black iron crutch, but her wrinkled old eyes shone with an extremely rare and solemn light. She took out an ice-blue jade slip from her sleeve and injected it with a ray of immortal essence. The image in the jade slip projected a broken star map in the void. The area marked on the star map is located at the junction of the outermost periphery of the Taixu Immortal Realm and the depths of the void, a remote abandoned cultivation star named Yunyin Star. Below the star map, there are several lines of brief records written in ancient characters. The general idea is that an ancient ruin that is too old to be traced has been discovered on this star. The stone tablet at the entrance to the ruins is engraved with spiral words of unknown meaning.
"This was recorded accidentally when I was traveling in the Taixu Immortal Realm when I was young. At that time, I was only in the early stage of Celestial Immortality. I accidentally broke into that star field and discovered the ruins. I wanted to explore in depth, but at the entrance of the ruins I encountered an ancient void beast of the Golden Immortal level. I tried my best to Li Cai barely escaped. Since then, he has not had the chance to return, and this star map has been suppressed in the depths of the Scripture Collection Pavilion for hundreds of thousands of years. I heard that you have a deep connection with the Xuming Clan. Instead of continuing to eat dust in the Scripture Collection Pavilion, I would like to leave it to you to find out. "
Jiang Chen took the ice blue jade slip, penetrated it with his spiritual consciousness, and completely carved the star map into the sea of consciousness. The location of Yunyin Star is just at the edge of the Eternal Dark Star Territory, not far from Guixu's new stronghold, and its strategic location is extremely critical. Grandma Xuan Shuang stood up with a cane, and a rare gentleness appeared on her old face: "I hope you can make up for the regrets I had when I was young."
The star map left by Granny Xuan Shuang was extremely detailed, but after all, it was a record she left when she was young. Hundreds of thousands of years have passed, and the space laws of the Ever Dark Star Territory have already shifted significantly. Jiang Chen took the Immortal Soul and two Sky-eating Insects with him, piloted the small void shuttle ship modified for him by the Taixu Sword Sect, and sailed on the edge of the Eternal Dark Star Field for several days before he found the abandoned cultivation star marked on the star map - Yunyin Star. The ship-based detection array was fully activated when it approached the planet. The feedback data made Jiang Chen frown slightly: there was no sign of life on the entire planet's surface, no spiritual energy fluctuations, no geothermal activity, and even the crustal movement that a normal planet should have.Stopped. This is not like a planet that died naturally, but more like it was emptied of all life from the inside by some force.
The shuttle ship penetrated the planet's thin to almost non-existent atmosphere and landed on a strangely flat dark purple wasteland. The moment Jiang Chen stepped out of the cabin, the touch of the ground his boot soles made made him frown even more - it was not a natural rock, but an artificial substance that had been smelted by some high temperature and then solidified again. He spread his spiritual consciousness with all his strength, extending in all directions along the ground. Every inch of land touched by his spiritual consciousness fed back the same information: the dark purple Void Clan formations densely covered the entire wasteland, extending from the surface to the depths of the ground that his spiritual consciousness could not reach. The scale of these formations far exceeded anything he had ever seen in the Ancient Ruins of the Void and the Dark Abyss Stronghold in the Eternal Dark Star Territory. They were not carved on the surface of the building, but were directly cast into the rocks of the entire planet.
The Immortal Soul followed him down the cabin. Its dark silver body shimmered slightly under the dark purple light of the wasteland, and its pair of pale silver eyes suddenly froze as it scanned the formations on the ground. It stood there for a long time, as if trying to remember something extremely distant, then placed its palm against the formation pattern and closed its eyes. After sensing it for a long time, it slowly spoke. The low resonance of the void contained a hint of complex emotions that even Jiang Chen had never heard before: "It's the breath of the tribe. It's very ancient, older than the teacher of Guixu. It's deeper." It moved its palm away from the formation pattern and pointed at the slightly raised crust in the center of the wasteland, "It's right below."
Jiang Chen pulled out the Abyss Devouring Sword. The third form of the Xuxu-breaking Sword Technique is a complete version of the Xuxu-cutting technique that incorporates the star laws of the Ten Thousand Stars Tempering Immortal Art. A transparent space crack hundreds of feet long cuts down with the blade of the sword, neatly slicing through the dark purple formations covering the surface of the earth and the several-mile-thick rock formation below. A huge crack was torn open in the rock formation, and a very faint but extremely pure dark golden light emerged from the depth of the crack. He flew down along the crack with his immortal soul, and the deeper he went, the more shocking he discovered the inside of the planet - the entire planet's underground had long been hollowed out, turning it into a giant three-dimensional maze made up of countless layers of Void Clan buildings. Each floor of the building is entirely carved from Void crystals, and is older and more grand than any Void Clan ruins he has seen in the Taixu Immortal Realm. In the deepest part, a completely sealed underground temple stood quietly. The outer wall of the temple was cast entirely by dark gold void crystals dozens of feet high. The lintel was engraved with spiral secret script. Every character was more primitive than those on the Gate of the Void, and it still retained the most original pictographic traces of the Void Clan's writing. The sealing formation is still in operation and has endured for countless thousands of years.
